name: cloudflared_recovery_privileges

sudoers.rationale: The safeguard writes this Linux sudoers grant and must account for it without treating it as scenario data.

storage.rationale: Linux-only system configuration is verified by the safeguard file check.

description: Write the minimal NOPASSWD sudoers grant (/etc/sudoers.d/tunnel-manager) that lets the non-root tunnel-manager process restart and reset-failed the root cloudflared systemd unit, so its auto-recovery loop can actuate without an interactive sudo prompt

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
